summary.name: Cutout.pro
summary.one_liner: Cutout.pro is a web platform offering AI image editing tools (background removal, photo enhancement, retouching), AI image and video generation models, and an API for integrating these into applications.
use_cases: remove backgrounds from product photos for e-commerce
create social media and flyer visuals
integrate image processing into apps via API
summary.what_it_does: The page lists a catalog of image editing tools including background remover, face cutout, object removal, photo enhancer and upscaler, photo colorizer, blur background, and image vectorizer. It also lists AI image generation tools (such as Cutout Image and several third-party-named models) and AI video generation models (such as Sora 2.0, Veo 3.1, and Seedance variants). A developer API is offered for integrating these capabilities into applications, with claims of batch processing of images and videos. Testimonials describe use for automatic video background removal and batch background removal.
notable: Broad catalog of AI image editing tools plus image and video generation models
Developer API for batch image and video processing
Automatic video background removal without green screens
caveats: Uptime is stated as a 98%+ guarantee and enterprise support is described as dedicated premium, suggesting paid business tiers, though specific prices are not on the page
Pricing and free-tier limits are not stated on the page; the listing tag '#free' is the only indication
